offering_description.value: Provides cloud-based software for healthcare organizations to train, credential, schedule and assess their workforce. Sells subscriptions to hospitals, health systems and other providers, delivered as software-as-a-service.

primary_products.value: learning management software; credentialing and provider enrollment software; staff scheduling software; competency assessment and performance tools; clinical education content

primary_services.value: provider credentialing verification; subscription-based online training and content; implementation and support

customer_segment.value: B2B: hospitals, health systems, physician practices, post-acute care providers, and life sciences organizations

end_markets.value: healthcare providers; hospitals and health systems; post-acute care; physician groups

revenue_model.value: subscription: annual or multi-year SaaS subscriptions for workforce, learning, credentialing and scheduling platforms; service fees: implementation, professional services and content fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops and hosts cloud workforce software and content, sold to healthcare organizations

geography_served.value: US national: Primarily United States healthcare organizations, with limited international customers

specialization.value: related lines: learning, credentialing, scheduling and performance tools for healthcare workforce management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: in-house sales team selling to healthcare organizations

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: healthcare data privacy (HIPAA) and accreditation standards such as Joint Commission and NCQA affect products
